name: Vizcaya Teen Environmental Council (VTEC)
what_you_do: Weekly Thursday sessions on city farming, green living and nature leadership for high school students. Members get a monthly stipend and service hours.
who_can_apply: High school students in 10th or 11th grade during the 2026-2027 school year. Apply and attend one info session (virtual or in person).
pay_detail: Monthly stipend (amount not stated) plus service hours
duration: Two semesters: Oct to Nov and Jan to Feb, Thursdays 4:30 to 6:30 pm; ends with an event Feb 28, 2027
deadline_text: The deadline for 2026-27 was Sunday, September 13, 2026. Watch the page for next year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Go to 1 info session (sign up on Eventbrite). You can join for 1 semester or both.
notes: No fee is listed. Stipend amount is not stated.
